examples.vi: Phương-pháp hữu hiệu nhất là chủng ngừa. Ở những nơi có bệnh thường xuyên người ta nhận thấy phải chủng ngừa tới 80% dân chúng trong vùng trong khoảng 5 năm mới mong tận diệt hết bệnh trong vùng (Davey và Lightbody. 1965).
examples.en: The most effective method is inoculation. In areas with regular disease outbreaks, it is observed that up to 80% of the population in the area must be inoculated in about 5 years' time to eradicate the disease in that area (Davey and Lighbody, 1965).

examples.en: Confucianism-Mencianism is not the monarchs' authoritarianism you guys think it is, no. Confucianism-Mencianism teaches reciprocal respect among monarchs and subjects, it's actually about equity; monarchs and subjects all need morality and ethics, meaning that subjects have to respect their monarchs like their own parents, and monarchs also have to love their subjects like their own children.
